explain_plans.sql: SELECT o.*,c.captured_at,c.representation,CASE WHEN o.identity_hmac IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM migration_history_observation x WHERE x.run_id=o.run_id AND x.organization_id=o.organization_id AND x.family=o.family AND x.identity_hmac=o.identity_hmac AND x.capture_sequence<=$3 AND x.primary_person_hmac IS DISTINCT FROM o.primary_person_hmac) THEN 'conflicting_reference' ELSE o.disposition END AS effective_link FROM migration_history_observation o JOIN migration_history_capture c ON c.id=o.capture_id AND c.run_id=o.run_id AND c.organization_id=o.organization_id WHERE o.run_id=$1 AND o.organization_id=$2 AND o.capture_sequence<=$3 AND ($4::text IS NULL OR o.family=$4) AND ($5::text IS NULL OR (CASE WHEN o.identity_hmac IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM migration_history_observation x WHERE x.run_id=o.run_id AND x.organization_id=o.organization_id AND x.family=o.family AND x.identity_hmac=o.identity_hmac AND x.capture_sequence<=$3 AND x.primary_person_hmac IS DISTINCT FROM o.primary_person_hmac) THEN 'conflicting_reference' ELSE o.disposition END)=$5) AND ($6::bytea IS NULL OR (o.identity_hmac=$6 AND o.family=$7)) AND ($8::uuid IS NULL OR o.id=$8) AND (o.capture_sequence,o.ordinal,o.id)>($9,$10,$11) ORDER BY o.capture_sequence,o.ordinal,o.id LIMIT $12
